apps.title: Apps

extension.title: Chrome extension for Gmail
extension.desc: See who wrote to you, log emails and track opens without leaving Gmail.
extension.featureSidebar: A panel next to each email with the sender's contact, deals and open tasks. If they are not in the CRM, you create them from there.
extension.featureLog: Log any email you receive or send in the contact timeline with one click.
extension.featureTrack: A "Log and track" box in each new email: it is logged when you send it and opens show up in the CRM.
extension.step1: Download the zip and unzip it. You get a zerosoft-crm folder.
extension.step3: Turn on Developer mode (top right) and click Load unpacked. Choose the zerosoft-crm folder.
extension.step4: In Settings, Workspace, API keys, create a key with CRM read and write access and copy it.
extension.step5: In the extension settings, paste the key and this app URL:
extension.step6: Open Gmail and an email: the panel shows up on the right.
extension.note: The extension acts as you: it sees the same records you see in the CRM. It is not in the Chrome Web Store yet, so it is installed from this zip.
